title: US-Soviet deconfliction on UFOs and NATO collaboration

tellings.quote: deterrence and the deconliction, as we already know, established between the United States and the Soviet Union on UFOs.

plain: The United States and the Soviet Union are said to have once set up an arrangement over UFOs, so that neither side would mistake one for an attack by the other. Matthew Brown, a former Pentagon official who presents himself as a whistleblower, says on the show that "deterrence and the deconfliction" on UFOs had been "established between the United States and the Soviet Union," and the story ties this to cooperation within NATO. If true, it would mean the Cold War rivals quietly treated UFOs as a shared problem.
